description: We are building a web platform that analyzes regional environmental data to determine optimal crop suitability. Our goal is to provide data-driven agricultural recommendations for farmers and researchers. We are looking for teammates interested in Web Development, Data Science, UI/UX, or Agriculture. If you want to build an impactful smart-agriculture tool, join us!
summary: Climate change and inefficient water usage pose critical threats to agriculture across Türkiye's diverse regions. To address this, we developed Skyield, an intelligent agricultural web platform designed for farmers across all 81 provinces of Türkiye. The platform optimizes crop rotation, soil pH adaptation, and regional climate suitability while integrating agrivoltaic principles. By analyzing real-time environmental data, Skyield guides farmers nationwide on what and when to plant, significantly reducing water consumption, chemical fertilizer use, and agricultural waste. This solution is vital for ensuring national food security, and promoting sustainable, climate-resilient farming practices across the entire country.
details: Skyield is an intelligent agricultural web platform designed to optimize crop management, soil health, and water utilization across all 81 provinces of Türkiye, adapting seamlessly to the country's diverse microclimates and geographic regions. It operates by analyzing real-time environmental data, weather forecasts, and soil pH levels to provide farmers nationwide with data-driven guidance on optimal crop rotation schedules and resource allocation, integrating agrivoltaic principles. The project directly addresses climate change-induced resource scarcity; by maximizing efficiency, Skyield significantly reduces water consumption, minimizes chemical fertilizer runoff, and prevents agricultural waste, ultimately strengthening national food security and helping local producers across Türkiye comply with modern green trade and export standards. To build this solution, we utilized modern web development frameworks, data analytics algorithms for climate-soil modeling, and geographic information systems (GIS) for nationwide mapping. Standing out through its innovative fusion of space-derived climate insights with terrestrial agricultural needs, our team carefully evaluated diverse regional climate vulnerabilities, farmers' economic constraints, nationwide scalability, and long-term environmental sustainability to create a practical, high-impact technological solution.
